• Navigation Hub Fix: Removed frozen background shift so More menu opens instantly without jumping the page
• Hub Grid Polish: Fixed word cropping across 2-line destination titles (Active Recall, To-Do Tasks, Shopping Lists, etc.)

• AI Action Automation: Resolved AI action proposal execution so commands to add tasks/expenses/lists directly commit to their interfaces
